a needle or token split across a line break - the instrument compares REFLOW-NORMALIZED text, and reports literal-only matches apart as contractsPresentOnlyAfterReflow

caveats: agent-teams-adopt --self-test is RED on this host and the manual is NOT the cause: its AGENTS.md assertion passes when run directly, and it then fails inside install-profile.mjs --self-test, which is red directly ('sidebar guard drifted from the bundle patch') because of an in-flight uncommitted mpd-bundle-plugin sidebar change in this working tree. The case also spawns a child with piped stdio, which is EPERM under this sandbox independently of the tree state.

verify-manual-paths was RED in the baseline run (unresolved=1 - .mpd/plans) and is green now because the manual no longer spells that gitignored runtime directory in a code span. The gate's verdict therefore depended on transient workspace state; the recommended follow-up is to classify .mpd/** as runtime state in the GATE, not to re-add a claim that a transient directory exists.
This change is manual-only: no gate script, no plugin source and no reference file was modified.
